V033-SPECIALIZED-DECODE.claim: DeepSeek V4.1 latency-specialized decode (decode_backend latency_specialized) raises ValueError at startup unless every gate in unsupported() holds: device capability 10.3 (labelled GB300/SM103), MRV2, tensor_parallel_size == 4 with no PP/DP/EP/DCP/PCP and no micro-batching, DSpark without adaptive verification, FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV41 with fp8/fp8_e4m3 KV, MXFP4 indexer with sparse logits, FULL decode graphs with non-FULL mixed batches (FULL_AND_PIECEWISE or FULL_DECODE_ONLY), no STOCK_TORCH_COMPILE, no sleep mode, no LoRA, no KV transfer config, no VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT, and DeepGEMM plus NVLink multicast for the fused all-reduce + mHC. P/D or KV-connector deployments, LoRA and sleep mode therefore exclude it.
V033-SPECIALIZED-DECODE.scope: Selected v0.33.0/v0.5.23 release review (reports/vllm-v033-upgrade.md, reports/sglang-v0523-upgrade.md); no binary, image or B300 execution.
